label: January 12–18
title: “In the Beginning God Created the Heaven and the Earth” —  Genesis

items.text: The Creation story teaches us that God can, over time, make something magnificent out of something unorganized. This is helpful to remember when life seems chaotic. Heavenly Father and Jesus Christ are Creators, and Their creative work with us is not finished. They can transform us into the divine beings we were meant to be.

Heavenly Father and Jesus Christ are Creators, and Their creative work with us is not finished. They can make light shine in dark moments in our lives. They can fill our emptiness with life. They can transform us into the divine beings we were meant to be. That’s what it means to be created in God’s image.

As you ponder the Creation accounts, consider what they teach you about Heavenly Father, Jesus Christ, the world, and yourself. God has chosen to reveal certain truths about the Creation, and understanding these can help us appreciate His divine power and plan for us.

Because I know I am created in God’s image, I choose to see myself and others with greater love and respect. This truth affects how I view my potential and can help me overcome negative feelings about myself, recognizing my divine heritage and potential for eternal growth.

To be created in God’s image means we have the potential to become like Him: exalted, glorified, and heavenly. This divine potential is a core truth that influences our self-worth and our eternal aspirations, reminding us of our divine parentage and destiny.

The Creation reveals God’s power and His desire to bring order and beauty into existence. It testifies of Jesus Christ, through whom all things were created. Understanding the Creation can deepen our faith and help us appreciate the majesty of the world around us.

Marriage between a man and a woman is ordained of God. Adam and Eve were joined together in marriage for time and for all eternity by the power of the everlasting priesthood. This sacred union is foundational to God’s plan and is to be treated with the reverence He has given it.

The creation of “man” in the image of God, male and female, emphasizes the divine nature and potential inherent in humanity. This truth empowers us to strive for godliness and understand our eternal relationship with our Heavenly Father and His Son, Jesus Christ.

As we learn about the Creation, we can feel reverence for the Creator. By observing God’s creations, we can gain a deeper appreciation for His power, wisdom, and love. Sharing these observations and our testimonies can strengthen faith in others.

The creation narrative demonstrates that even from a state of void and desolation, God can bring forth life and beauty. This principle applies to our own lives; God can bring light into our darkness and fill our emptiness, transforming us into His divine children.
